properties.description: Migrated from DataStage Server Job 'CopyOfJ990_Jen_Extraccion_IB' (DateModified: 2025-03-28). Variant that reads from the ARCHIVE table journal.dbo.jen_old3 instead of jen. Same logic as PROD but points to historical data. Filter: jen_fec_evt_neg = dateadd(-7, FechaProceso) AND SUBSTRING(jen_ope_evt,1,2)='IB'.

activities.name: ExecuteDataFlow_Trf_Jen_Old3
activities.description: Replicates DataStage flow: CODBCStage(Sybase_Jen_IBM_7_Dias on jen_old3) -> CTransformerStage(Trf_Jen) -> CSeqFileStage(Seq_Jen).

query.value: SELECT jen_ope_evt, jen_fec_evt_neg, jen_fec_ctb_evt, jen_rut_cli, jen_vrf_cli, jen_rut_emp, jen_vrf_emp, jen_id_cnl, jen_est_cnl, jen_suc_ori, jen_med, jen_id_med, jen_tip_opr_bci, jen_id_opr, jen_mod_tar, jen_fra_lin, jen_ara_cua, jen_id_svs, jen_est_evt_neg, jen_id_pdt, jen_id_evt, jen_id_sub_evt, jen_clv_ppl, jen_mto, jen_clv_sgd, jen_cpo_var FROM @{pipeline().parameters.DBO_Journal}.jen_old3 WHERE CAST(jen_fec_evt_neg AS DATE) = DATEADD(day, -7, CAST('@{pipeline().parameters.FechaProceso}' AS DATE)) AND SUBSTRING(jen_ope_evt, 1, 2) = 'IB'

FechaProceso.description: Process date YYYY-MM-DD. Maps to DataStage $FechaProceso.

FechaArchExtraccion.description: File date YYYYMMDD. Maps to DataStage $FechaArchExtraccion.

DBO_Journal.description: Schema/owner. Maps to DataStage $DBO_Journal. Table used: {DBO_Journal}.jen_old3.

NombreJob.description: Job name for output file. Maps to DataStage $NombreJob.

annotations: difference_from_prod: reads jen_old3 (archive) instead of jen (current)
source_filter: jen_fec_evt_neg = dateadd(-7, FechaProceso) AND SUBSTRING(jen_ope_evt,1,2)='IB'
